# Moved: GitHub configuration lives at the repository root

The git root of `maz279/1000fix_new_erp_system` is the workspace, not this
codebase directory. GitHub reads `.github/workflows/`, `.github/settings.yml`
(Probot) and `CODEOWNERS` **only at the repository root**, so files kept here
were silently ignored (no workflow could ever trigger; no ownership rule
applied). R01 re-audit 2026-10-22 moved them to:

- `../.github/workflows/ci.yml` - pipeline (runs with `working-directory: 1000_fix_codebase`)
- `../.github/settings.yml` - branch protection (Probot Settings)
- `../.github/CODEOWNERS` - generated by `tooling/generators/generate-codeowners.ps1`
- `../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`, `../.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`

Structural check: `python tooling/ci/validate-workflow.py`.
